strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with per-shard scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 16 sequential all_reduce operations with alternating scale-reduce and unscale patterns between iterations. Each all_reduce operates on the full (world_size*256) tensor. Expected dispatch count: 16 all_reduce calls. Represents the baseline approach with maximum dispatch overhead but simplest logic, directly matching the reference implementation's structure.

strategies.name: Fused scaling with batched all-reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-compute all scaling operations in a single fused kernel, then execute all 16 all_reduce operations back-to-back to enable potential hardware pipelining. Post-process results with a single fused unscaling kernel. Expected dispatch count: 1 fused scale + 16 all_reduce + 1 fused unscale = 18 dispatches. Trades additional computation fusion for potential overlap of consecutive collectives.

strategies.name: Chunked tensor with parallel sub-collectives
strategies.desc: Split the tensor into chunks and pipeline the 16 iterations across different chunks using overlapping all_reduce operations on smaller payloads. Leverage async dispatch to hide latency by starting iteration i+1 on chunk B while iteration i completes on chunk A. Expected dispatch count: 32-48 dispatches depending on chunk count. Trades more dispatches for reduced per-dispatch latency and better pipeline utilization.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc: Transform each all_reduce into a reduce_scatter followed by local computation on the reduced shard, then all_gather to redistribute. For 16 iterations, use 16 reduce_scatter operations with fused local scaling, then a final all_gather. Expected dispatch count: 16 reduce_scatter + 1 all_gather = 17 dispatches. Reduces total communication volume by avoiding full-tensor replication in intermediate steps.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level collective with intra-node fusion
strategies.desc:
Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all_reduce with fused scaling (fewer participants = lower latency), then inter-node all_reduce for the aggregated results, repeated across 16 iterations. Within each node, fuse all local operations. Expected dispatch count: 32 collectives (16 intra-node + 16 inter-node). Optimizes for NUMA-aware hardware where local aggregation is significantly faster than cross-node communication.
